building: Purdue Magnetic Resonance Imaging Facility (MRI1 / PMRI)

criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS BuildingShapesZip4 FID 918 explicitly identifies PMRI at 750 S University Street; Office of Research cross-references MRI1/PMRI. Independently recomputed from saved FID 918 WGS84 polygon: all four structural base edges match the reopened mesh within 0.00002743 m.
criteria.limitations: GIS accuracy is unpublished and not survey-grade; OSM centroid is 1.70 m offset, so Purdue GIS is correctly treated as footprint control.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Reopened mesh is in campus coordinates with identity object transform; exact four-edge source geometry confirms plan placement, dimensions, and orientation against the official GIS outline. The export agrees to sub-millimeter tolerance.
criteria.limitations: Campus transform is an approximate local geographic conversion, not a surveyed CRS; source positional accuracy is unknown.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS level fields and Meyer Najem project description support a single-story facility. Aerial tile supports a low flat roof and rooftop mechanical equipment; model shows that roof type and equipment.
criteria.limitations: No measured elevations or wall height are available. Model wall height 4.5 m, parapet/roof height 5.15 m, and HVAC top at 5.85 m are estimates; roof pitch, parapet details, and equipment dimensions are not verified.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Contractor project record supports masonry veneer plus aluminum windows and doors; the saved mesh uses masonry walls and aluminum-framed openings. No retrieved exact-building exterior photo is available for direct comparison.
criteria.limitations: Window rhythm, east-facing entry, MRI sign placement, and detailed facade appearance are not evidenced by an accessible exterior view; those details remain illustrative/inferred.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Cold reopened asset matches manifest path and collection, has one mesh object, identity transform, no modifiers, no file-backed images, preserved preview renders, raw GIS and multiple independent source snapshots, and a structured evidence record. Checks: {"all_four_GIS_structural_edges_within_2mm": true, "asset_file_reopened": true, "expected_collection_contains_only_target_mesh": true, "identity_transform": true, "manifest_asset_matches": true, "no_external_file_images": true, "no_modifiers": true}
criteria.limitations: None found in the saved asset packaging; model fidelity remains subject to source limitations recorded above.

findings: Passes the 8/10 threshold, at the minimum passing score.
Keep the vertical height labeled estimated; no dimensional elevation source was found.
If exact facade accuracy is required, obtain a usable current exterior photo/elevation and verify the entrance bearing, window spacing, and MRI signage before revising those details.
